first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A figure wearing a light gray-white hood, a dark brown top, and a light-colored split hanging cloth, with a long yellow-ochre cloth strip at the waist, and carrying a round shield and longbow on the back.

entities.name: stone passageway
entities.identification: A walkable light pink-beige stone surface connecting the foreground path, platform, and entrance to the stone steps.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: A figure lying on the foreground passageway, with only parts of bent legs, dark footwear, and clothing visible at the bottom edge.

entities.name: cage brazier
entities.identification: A black cylindrical metal cage container inside the parapet wall on the left, with a crossed grate on top.

entities.name: stone steps
entities.identification: Wide, straight light pink-beige stone steps with thick sloping sidewalls.

entities.name: wooden stake fence
entities.identification: A densely arranged gray-brown wooden stake fence along the platform's outer edge, with an uneven top edge.

entities.name: stone building complex
entities.identification: The collection of light pink-brown and ochre-yellow stone buildings visible in this clip, including the houses on the far side of the platform and the thick walls and tower-like masses on both sides of the stone steps; it may overlap with the tower-wall complex subset.

entities.name: layered rock face
entities.identification: The irregular layered rock formation, ranging from reddish brown to light ochre yellow, visible in the upper right of the first frame.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The bright light gray-white to pale yellow-gray sky visible between and above the outlines of the buildings and terrain.

entities.name: vegetation
entities.identification: Dark green to yellow-green shrubs, grasses, and distant tree crowns outside the platform and at the bases of the walls.

entities.name: sandy ground
entities.identification: The exposed light yellow-brown ground at a lower level outside the platform and between the buildings.

entities.name: domed stone parapet wall
entities.identification: A thick light pink-beige stone parapet wall with repeating rounded capstones whose front faces have recessed borders and faded pale red markings.

entities.name: longbow
entities.identification: The slender yellow-brown curved bow limb slung diagonally behind Person A and extending above the shoulder and toward the waist.

entities.name: round shield
entities.identification: The nearly circular dark green-black shield on Person A's back, with pale gold curved ornamentation on its surface.

entities.name: woven mat
entities.identification: A large gray-brown, nearly rectangular mat covering the platform's stone surface, with dense fine striped texture on its surface.

entities.name: thin black cable
entities.identification: The thin black linear cable crossing the sky between the buildings in the first frame and sagging slightly downward.
